segments.text: An is a third-year at Mihaya Academy and the current student council president. Though she is a beauty who even fascinates girls, the "perfect" impression of her somewhat worsens as soon as she opens her mouth. She’s a girl that acts intimate only to slip through the gaps of your fingers the very next moment, like a butterfly. Resulting from a chance meeting with the one year younger Yuuma, she becomes interested in him and constantly tries to get him join the student council.
美颯学園３年生。現生徒会長。
同性でも見惚れるほどの美貌を持つが、口を開くと少し残念。
親しく接してきたかと思えば、はらりと手から逃れていく胡蝶のような女の子。
ふとしたことから年下の悠真に興味を持ち、生徒会に引き込もうとする。
明るく元気な人気者だが、狙った獲物は逃さないという一面も。

「今日からキミ、あたしの下僕ね♪」

Mio is Yuuma's childhood friend and the daughter of a shrine family. She is an honest, gentle girl, but also has a profound fear regarding the opposite sex. Due to that constitution, it makes her unable to have any physical contact with men, however, Yuuma helps her with rehabilitation by holding hands with her on the way to school every day. Mio is also a closet pervert and likes BL. She often has weird delusions when confronted with suggestive situations.
悠真の幼なじみで、神社の娘巫女。
素直で優しい女の子だが、男性に対してはひどく人見知りする。
異性には触れることすらできない体質なため、悠真が毎朝手をつないで登校することでリハビリに協力している。
ちなみに、むっつりスケベである。

「春っていいよー？　暖かいし、色々な出会いがあるし、お花もいっぱい咲くしー」

Yuuri is a second-year at Mihaya Highschool and currently the stand-in Public Morals Committee Chairman. She is a girl with a strong sense of responsibility that can firmly state her opinion to girls and boys alike. Apart from that, she is also virtuous to the extent that she turns away when there is a kissing scene in a TV drama. Probably originating in the fact that she has only been attending all-girls schools before, it always seem like she is building a wall around her when in contact with boys. Being close friends with Mio, it makes her also interested in Yuuma, at least as long as it concerns Mio. She also works part-time in the school's cafeteria as a maid to earn extra money. She finds the work enjoyable and is quite satisfied with it. Yuuri thinks that love is stupid due to special circumstances.
美颯学園２年生。風紀委員長代理。
真面目で責任感が強く、異性相手でも物怖じすることなく意見を言う。
ドラマのキスシーンすら目を背けるほどの潔癖症で、恋愛に対して否定的。
女子校育ちのためか、男子には常に壁を隔てている印象がある。
美桜とは親友の仲だが、それだけに悠真の言動が気になるようだ。

「お気遣いありがとう。 ……でもお構いなく。そんなにか弱くはありませんので」

Konami is a first-year at Mihaya Academy and Yuuma's little sister. In contrast to her looks, she’s a very composed person. She is also an honor student that can handle just about anything flawlessly. She doesn't see Yuuma as a member of the opposite sex at all, meaning that she’s perfectly fine with seeing him naked, or having him see her undressed.

Due to the influence of their now deceased father, shogi became her hobby, and she is quite skilled at it. Despite her skills, she has never won against Yuuma. Her favorite piece is the knight, and it makes her heart break whenever that piece is taken during a game.
Due to some reason, she also got a wanted poster at school with the reward money of 102900 Yen (before tax) for capturing her, causing Yuuma to have another cause for headaches.
美颯学園１年生。悠真の妹。
顔に似合わずクールな性格で、なんでもソツなくこなす優等生。
兄の悠真に対しては異性の意識がまったくなく、下着を見られようが兄の裸を見ようが特に気にしない。
亡くなった父親の影響で将棋が趣味、腕はかなりのもの。
好きな駒は桂馬で、対局中にそれを獲られると心が折れる。

「妹の月経周期を知り尽くした兄って、一歩まちがったらアレだよね」

The self-proclaimed Love Fairy Tina suddenly appears before Yuuma one day. Having no place to go, this mysterious girl settles at Yuma’s place. Her goal is apparently to have Yuuma fall in love with a girl and to fulfill that love. Her special skills are "sleeping together", "eating together", "holding hands when leaving the house" and more amazing stuff. On top of her head rests her familiar Kotarou who possesses terrifying powers (according to her).
自称・恋の妖精。
突然、悠真の元に現れて「行くところがない」と家に住み着いてしまう謎の少女。
悠真に恋をさせ、それを叶えるのが目的らしい。
特殊能力は「添い寝」「一緒にご飯を食べる」「手をつないでおでかけ」など。
頭の上には、恐ろしい力を持つ使い魔（本人談）コタローを乗せている。

突然 悠真のもとに現れて、「行くところがない」 と家に住み着いてしまう謎の少女。
悠真に恋をさせ、それを叶えるのが目的らしい。
特殊能力は “添い寝” “一緒にご飯を食べる” “手をつないでおでかけ” など。
頭の上には、恐ろしい力を持つ使い魔 （※本人談） コタローを乗せている。
「わたしは、あなたの恋を叶えにきました」

Yuuma is a second-year at Mihaya Academy and sort of a celebrity on campus. In spite of being rather blunt, he’s a person that deeply cares for others. He simply can’t leave troubled people alone when he sees them. Being a Sanitary Committee Member, he’s helping out at the school infirmary during breaks and after school. His work there includes listening to the love troubles of girls and offering them his advice. However, that eventually led to him becoming the focus of romantic interests. At school, he’s known as the “Wanted Guy” with a reward money of 21000 Yen (before tax) for successfully capturing him. The reward money goes up considerably as days passed much to his annoyance.
本作の主人公。 美颯学園の2年生で、学園内ではちょっとした有名人。
ぶっきらぼうだが面倒見が良く、困っている人を見ると放っておけない。
保健委員として保健室の仕事を手伝い、休み時間や放課後、女子たちから恋の相談を受けているうちに、自分が「恋される」側になってしまった。
学園内では女子たちから恋の賞金首として21000円 （税込）の懸賞金がかけられている。

Hanako is Yuuri's older twin sister. An awkward character that can't be straightforward. Despite being twins, her personality is the complete opposite of Yuuri's, often causing people around her trouble. For some reason, she sees Yuuma as her enemy. She's also competitive towards Yuuri, often trying to best her in many areas... though it's completely one-sided on her part and Yuuri is oblivious to this.

Yuuma often teases her whenever they talk (or more like whenever Hanako confronts him) due to her personality, which incites funny reactions from her. A member and also the president of the newspaper club, she always brings her digital camera where ever she goes in order to capture pictures about hot topics to put in her articles. She's pretty passionate about her occupation, which is also where her interest lies. She's pretty confident about her abilities. She doesn't like being called "Hanako" and prefers to be called the "Portrait Assassin".
美颯学園２年生。夕莉の双子の姉。
何につけても素直になれない、捻くれた性格の持ち主。
夕莉とはいいコンビで傍目には大変仲良しに見えるのだが、それを言うと違うわよっ！と否定する。照れ隠しである。
新聞部に所属しており、スクープ狙いで普段から首に提げているデジタルカメラの「スレイプニール」が相棒。

Nao is the school nurse of Mihaya Academy. She doesn't have much motivation and hates trouble. Born in the same year as Aoi, she was the student of Yuma and Konami's father. Because of this relation, she sees Yuma and Konami as her younger siblings. When Yuma and Konami were still kids, she often comes to their home to take care of them like an older sister. She has been very close friends with Aoi ever since they were just students. She manages and supervises the female dorm, and has earned the student's admiration and reliance.
She used to be Miyu's senpai back in her school days.
美颯学園の養護教諭、いわゆる保健の先生。面倒くさがりで、いつも気だるそうにしている。
葵とは同期生で、かつては悠真の父の教え子だった。
その関係もあり、悠真のことは実の弟のように可愛がっている（本人はそのつもり）。
女子寮の管理・監督も任されており、意外と生徒たちからも慕われ頼りにされている。

Aoi is the PE teacher in Mihaya Highschool and is Yuuma's homeroom teacher. She is both Yuuma and Konami's mother. A kind and loving woman, she still loves both Yuuma and Konami like her own children and also likes to dote on them, despite having no blood relation to them. She adopted the two of them when their father (who was also Aoi's mentor) and her husband suddenly died.

She's a good mother at home and loved by her students at school, however she's quite easily flustered and can be clumsy when she's in that state, which often makes the students fawn all over her cuteness. Even though she's a mother and a widow, she's still in her 20s, often shocking others when she tells them about it. She's very close friends with Nao, as both of them were Konami and Yuuma's father's students.
美颯学園の体育教師。悠真の義理の母親で学園では担任も務める。
穏やかで子供好き、血はつながっていないものの悠真とこなみのことは実の子のように愛している。
悠真の父は学生時代の恩師で、数年前に急逝。残された悠真たちを引き取った。
家では良き母であるが、年頃の男子にとっては少々スキンシップが激しすぎる一面も？

Sou is a second year student and the Student Council Vice President. He met Yuuma during the entrance exams and they somehow became friends after that. He has a rather optimistic and carefree personality and often sleeps during classes, which makes you wonder why he's the Student Council Vice President in the first place. He also has a crazy fetish for chubby girls, and often encourages other girls to "eat more", which makes him being labeled as a weirdo or a pervert by quite a lot of people. Ironically, quite a lot of girls thinks he's actually good looking so long as he keeps his mouth shut. Sadly, his crazy fetish and his tendency to push it onto others causes quite a lot of girls to avoid him, though strangely that doesn't completely stop him from being popular with some of the girls, especially first years.
颯学園２年生で生徒会の副会長を務めている。
のんきで楽観的な性格だが、それが真逆とも言える悠真と波長が合うらしい。
イケメンで黙っていれば女子にもモテるタイプだが、ふくよか系の女子にしか興味を示さないため、見かけの割に女性関係は派手でない。
生徒会役員として、日々「もっとごはんを食べよう！」と訴え続けている。
Tina's older sister, and the shinigami who saved Yuma's life. She died after resurecting him.

Kotarou is Tina's familiar. He looks just like a stuffed animal, and he talks in a rather formal and spiritless way. According to Tina, he's supposed to promote Yuuma's love, but he seems to care little for the troubles of humans. Tina would often treat him rather poorly when she's in a foul mood or when Kotarou incites her anger, though half the time it is because Kotarou's blunt comments irritate her. But even though he gives off a blunt personality, he seems to care deeply for Tina's well being and would often give her advice or lecture her when she does something unreasonable.

However, even though he might look weak and helpless, he truly holds fearsome powers within him. Kotarou is not merely Tina's familiar, but also her fearsome and protective guardian. He uses this power to change into his true form whenever he needs to protect Tina from harm. His true form is that of a giant wolf, and the power he gives off would make anyone think twice before even attempting to confront him. His reasons for staying by Tina's side and where he comes from is unknown.

Miyu is Mio's kind older sister and a university student. She's often found at the shrine when she's not attending campus, taking care of the place and doing various work as a miko. When they were kids, Miyu used to play together with Mio, Yuuma, and Konami. She's quite fond of Yuuma, and sometimes teases him when they meet, albeit in a different way than Konami does.
She is on good terms with Nao and Aoi, who were both her upperclassmen during their high school times.

Elle is the other side of An's split personality and a shinigami, two souls in one body. During the day, An goes to school and enjoy her life, while during night time in her sleep, Elle takes over to do their 'shinigami duties'. Elle seems to care a lot for An and would do anything to make her happy.

A shinigami that seems to know Tina and Kotarou. He met with Yuma due to the encounter when he raided his room to take Tina back, but changed his mind afterwards. He immediately took a great interest in Yuma the moment he laid eyes on him. He then declares that he will "make Yuma his" after apparently getting rejected flat by Yuma instantly after his approach, much to Yuma's annoyance and disgust.

segments.text: The deceased father of Yuma and Konami. He died due to an illness when Yuma and Konami are still kids. The shinigami Tina and Hyberion gave the Asaba family one chance to meet him again for a short time. He loves Aoi and both his children from the bottom of his heart, and would pray for nothing more than their happiness.
Appears in Konami's route.

Pannya is a strange, female cat-like creature that lives on the campus of Yuihime Girls' Academy. She is close to Miu. Her name "Pannya" comes from "panda" and "nyanko". (The English name "Panditty" comes from "panda" and "kitty").
From Wikipedia
A freshman student who appears only in Yuuri's route. She comes into the infirmary brandishing a magazine featuring a page which Yuuri had modelled in. Yuuri ends up confiscating the magazine.

Koharu is Sou's younger cousin and also his girlfriend. She has been in love with him since forever but he noticed just some time before and they started going out the day before her hospitalisation. Sou promised her that they would go to a date together once she was discharged from the hospital, but her health deteriorated very quickly after that...
